title.en: What the Prairies and British Columbia produce
title.fr: Ce que produisent les Prairies et la Colombie-Britannique

text.en: The Prairie Provinces are rich in energy resources. They also have some of the most fertile farmland.
text.fr: Les provinces des Prairies sont riches en ressources énergétiques. Elles ont aussi certaines des terres agricoles les plus fertiles.

source.quote: the Prairie Provinces, rich in energy resources and some of the most fertile farmland

verification.evidence: Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces, rich in energy resources and some of the most fertile farmland in the world.

text.en: Manitoba's economy rests on farming, mining and making hydro-electric power.
text.fr: L'économie du Manitoba repose sur l'agriculture, les mines et la production d'hydroélectricité.

source.quote: Manitoba’s economy is based on agriculture, mining and hydro-electric power generation

verification.evidence: Manitoba’s economy is based on agriculture, mining and hydro-electric power generation

text.en: Saskatchewan grows more grains and oilseeds than any other province.
text.fr: La Saskatchewan produit plus de céréales et d'oléagineux que toute autre province.

source.quote: is the country’s largest producer of grains and oilseeds.

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,” has 40% of the arable land in Canada and is the country’s largest producer of grains and oilseeds.

text.en: Saskatchewan has the richest deposits of uranium and potash in the world. Potash is used in fertilizer.
text.fr: La Saskatchewan possède les plus riches gisements d'uranium et de potasse au monde. La potasse sert à fabriquer des engrais.

source.quote: It also boasts the world’s richest deposits of uranium and potash, used in fertilizer

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,” has 40% of the arable land in Canada and is the country’s largest producer of grains and oilseeds. It also boasts the world’s richest deposits of uranium and potash, used in fertilizer

text.en: Saskatoon, the province's biggest city, is where the mining industry has its headquarters. It is also an important centre for education, research and technology.
text.fr: Saskatoon, la plus grande ville de la province, est le siège de l'industrie minière. C'est aussi un centre important d'éducation, de recherche et de technologie.

source.quote: Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry and an important educational, research and technology centre.

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan … Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry and an important educational, research and technology centre.

text.en: Alberta produces more oil and gas than any other province.
text.fr: L'Alberta est la province qui produit le plus de pétrole et de gaz.

source.quote: Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas

verification.evidence: Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas, and the oil sands in the north are being developed as a major energy source.

text.en: In the north of Alberta, the oil sands are being developed as a major source of energy.
text.fr: Dans le nord de l'Alberta, les sables bitumineux sont mis en valeur comme grande source d'énergie.

source.quote: the oil sands in the north are being developed as a major energy source

verification.evidence: Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas, and the oil sands in the north are being developed as a major energy source.

text.en: Alberta is also famous for farming, above all for its huge cattle ranches. Because of them, Canada is one of the biggest producers of beef in the world.
text.fr: L'Alberta est aussi réputée pour son agriculture, surtout pour ses immenses ranchs de bétail. Grâce à eux, le Canada est l'un des grands producteurs de bœuf au monde.

source.quote: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.

verification.evidence: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.

text.en: A large share of the goods made in B.C. are forestry products. These include lumber, newsprint, and pulp and paper products.
text.fr: Une grande part des biens produits en Colombie-Britannique sont des produits forestiers, comme le bois d'œuvre, le papier journal et les produits de pâtes et papiers.

source.quote: of all the goods produced in B.C. are forestry products, including lumber, newsprint, and pulp and paper products

verification.evidence: About one-half of all the goods produced in B.C. are forestry products, including lumber, newsprint, and pulp and paper products

text.en: The Port of Vancouver is the largest and busiest port in Canada.
text.fr: Le port de Vancouver est le plus grand et le plus achalandé du Canada.

source.quote: The Port of Vancouver, Canada’s largest and busiest

verification.evidence: The Port of Vancouver, Canada’s largest and busiest, handles billions of dollars in goods traded around the world.
